999008199.text:
ケイウンでは、赤と白の組み合わせは紅白といって
めでたいものなんだそうです

localizations.en: In Keiun, the combination of red and white is called kōhaku, and it's considered very auspicious.

999008199.text:
私のこの衣装も、紅白が基調となっているので
まさにめでたい年始に着るのにぴったりだとか！

localizations.en: My outfit is based on those colors, so apparently it's perfect for wearing during this celebratory time of year!

999008199.text:
そういえば、花嫁の衣装にも紅白のものがありましたね
……もしかして、ケイウンが発祥の文化なのでしょうか

localizations.en: Come to think of it, some bridal outfits also feature red and white... Could it be that this cultural tradition originated in Keiun?

999008199.text:
考え始めたら、真偽が気になってきました！
一緒に鏑矢さんに聞きに行きましょう！

localizations.en: Now that I've started thinking about it, I really want to know if that's true! Let's go ask Kaburaya together!
